# HR Benefits and Development Strategy Review

This document outlines key strategic initiatives and review cycles for Human Resources.

*   Optimize medical insurance for strategy 2026.
*   Optimize medical insurance based on audit findings.
*   Optimize bonus structure based on audit findings.
*   Review bonus structure quarterly.
*   Review career development quarterly.
